topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Past or Present Perfect
title: Simple Past or Present Perfect?

explanation.tr:
Bu iki zaman Türkçede aynı çevrilebilir ama İngilizcede farklıdır:
• Simple Past: zamanı BELLİ ve bitmiş geçmiş → I saw him yesterday. She lived in Paris in 2010.
  Sinyal: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when…?
• Present Perfect: zamanı belirsiz ya da şimdiye bağlı → I have seen this film. She has lived here since 2010.
  Sinyal: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far
• Soru: When did you arrive? (✓) – When have you arrived? (✗)
• Deneyim sorusu Present Perfect, ayrıntılar Simple Past: Have you been to Rome? – Yes, I went there last year.
explanation.tk:
Bu iki zaman türkmen dilinde birmeňzeş terjime edilip bilner, emma iňlis dilinde tapawutly:
• Simple Past: wagty BELLI we gutaran geçmiş → I saw him yesterday. She lived in Paris in 2010.
  Alamat: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when…?
• Present Perfect: wagty näbelli ýa-da häzir bilen bagly → I have seen this film. She has lived here since 2010.
  Alamat: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far
• Sorag: When did you arrive? (✓) – When have you arrived? (✗)
• Tejribe soragy Present Perfect, jikme-jiklik Simple Past: Have you been to Rome? – Yes, I went there last year.
explanation.ru:
На русский эти времена часто переводятся одинаково, но в английском они разные:
• Simple Past: время УКАЗАНО, действие закончено → I saw him yesterday. She lived in Paris in 2010.
  Маркеры: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when…?
• Present Perfect: время не указано или связь с настоящим → I have seen this film. She has lived here since 2010.
  Маркеры: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for, so far
• Вопрос: When did you arrive? (✓) – When have you arrived? (✗)
• Об опыте — Present Perfect, подробности — Simple Past: Have you been to Rome? – Yes, I went there last year.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or Present Progressive
title: Simple Present or Present Progressive?

explanation.tr:
• Simple Present: her zaman, genelde, alışkanlık → I play football every Sunday.
  Sinyal: always, usually, often, every day, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: şu an, bu aralar → I am playing football now.
  Sinyal: now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!
• Karşılaştır:
  She usually drinks tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
• Durum fiilleri (like, love, know, want) Simple Present'te kalır: I like this song. (I'm liking ✗)
explanation.tk:
• Simple Present: hemişe, adatça, endik → I play football every Sunday.
  Alamat: always, usually, often, every day, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: häzir, şu günler → I am playing football now.
  Alamat: now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!
• Deňeşdir:
  She usually drinks tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
• Ýagdaý işlikleri (like, love, know, want) Simple Present-de galýar: I like this song. (I'm liking ✗)
explanation.ru:
• Simple Present: всегда, обычно, привычка → I play football every Sunday.
  Маркеры: always, usually, often, every day, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: сейчас, в эти дни → I am playing football now.
  Маркеры: now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!
• Сравни:
  She usually drinks tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
• Глаголы состояния (like, love, know, want) — в Simple Present: I like this song. (I'm liking ✗)

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or Simple Past – easy sentences
title: Simple Present or Simple Past? (Easy)

explanation.tr:
• Simple Present: şimdi/her zaman → I live in Mary. She works in a bank.
• Simple Past: geçmişte bitti → I lived in Dashoguz. She worked in a shop.
Zaman ifadesine bak:
• every day, usually, now (durum), always → Simple Present
• yesterday, last week, ago, in 2015 → Simple Past
Şekiller: work → works (he/she) / worked; go → goes / went; have → has / had; be → am/is/are / was/were
explanation.tk:
• Simple Present: häzir/hemişe → I live in Mary. She works in a bank.
• Simple Past: geçmişde gutardy → I lived in Dashoguz. She worked in a shop.
Wagt aňlatmasyna seret:
• every day, usually, now (ýagdaý), always → Simple Present
• yesterday, last week, ago, in 2015 → Simple Past
Görnüşler: work → works (he/she) / worked; go → goes / went; have → has / had; be → am/is/are / was/were
explanation.ru:
• Simple Present: сейчас/всегда → I live in Mary. She works in a bank.
• Simple Past: закончилось в прошлом → I lived in Dashoguz. She worked in a shop.
Смотри на выражение времени:
• every day, usually, now (состояние), always → Simple Present
• yesterday, last week, ago, in 2015 → Simple Past
Формы: work → works (he/she) / worked; go → goes / went; have → has / had; be → am/is/are / was/were

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or Simple Past
title: Simple Present or Simple Past?

explanation.tr:
Zaman seçerken kendine sor: 'Bu şimdi/her zaman mı doğru, yoksa geçmişte bitti mi?'
• Simple Present: alışkanlık, genel gerçek, şimdiki durum
  He takes the bus to work. Cats like fish.
• Simple Past: geçmişte belli bir zamanda bitti
  He took a taxi this morning. (bu sabah bitti)
• Hikâye anlatırken geçmiş zaman kullanılır: Once upon a time, a king lived in a big palace.
• Dikkat: Simple Present'te 3. tekil -s; Simple Past'ta tüm öznelerde aynı biçim.
explanation.tk:
Zamany saýlanyňda özüňden sora: 'Bu häzir/hemişe dogrumy ýa-da geçmişde gutardymy?'
• Simple Present: endik, umumy hakykat, häzirki ýagdaý
  He takes the bus to work. Cats like fish.
• Simple Past: geçmişde belli bir wagtda gutardy
  He took a taxi this morning. (şu gün irden gutardy)
• Erteki/hekaýa gürrüň berlende geçmiş zaman ulanylýar: Once upon a time, a king lived in a big palace.
• Üns beriň: Simple Present-de 3-nji ýöňkeme birlikde -s; Simple Past-da ähli eýelerde birmeňzeş görnüş.
explanation.ru:
Выбирая время, спроси себя: 'Это верно сейчас/всегда или закончилось в прошлом?'
• Simple Present: привычка, общая истина, текущее состояние
  He takes the bus to work. Cats like fish.
• Simple Past: закончилось в определённый момент прошлого
  He took a taxi this morning. (утро уже прошло)
• В рассказах используется прошедшее время: Once upon a time, a king lived in a big palace.
• Внимание: в Simple Present 3-е лицо ед. ч. с -s; в Simple Past форма одинакова для всех.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or Simple Past – negative sentences
title: Negatives: Simple Present or Simple Past?

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz cümlelerde yardımcı fiil zamanı gösterir:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + yalın fiil
  I don't like fish. She doesn't work here.
• Simple Past: didn't + yalın fiil (tüm özneler)
  I didn't like the film. She didn't work yesterday.
• be fiili: isn't/aren't/am not ↔ wasn't/weren't
  He isn't at home now. He wasn't at home last night.
Dikkat: doesn't ve didn't sonrası fiil yalın: She didn't went (✗) → She didn't go (✓).
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk sözlemlerde kömekçi işlik zamany görkezýär:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + esasy işlik
  I don't like fish. She doesn't work here.
• Simple Past: didn't + esasy işlik (ähli eýeler)
  I didn't like the film. She didn't work yesterday.
• be işligi: isn't/aren't/am not ↔ wasn't/weren't
  He isn't at home now. He wasn't at home last night.
Üns beriň: doesn't we didn't-dan soň işlik esasy görnüşde: She didn't went (✗) → She didn't go (✓).
explanation.ru:
В отрицаниях время показывает вспомогательный глагол:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + начальная форма
  I don't like fish. She doesn't work here.
• Simple Past: didn't + начальная форма (для всех лиц)
  I didn't like the film. She didn't work yesterday.
• Глагол be: isn't/aren't/am not ↔ wasn't/weren't
  He isn't at home now. He wasn't at home last night.
Внимание: после doesn't и didn't — начальная форма: She didn't went (✗) → She didn't go (✓).
